configuration.summary:
Building software is more than just writing code. It's about exploring ideas, solving problems, experimenting with technologies, and turning concepts into something useful.

Over the years, I've worked on a variety of projects, ranging from academic and personal experiments to practical applications and open-source tools. Some were built to solve real-world problems, others to explore an interesting idea or simply satisfy my curiosity.

I enjoy building things from scratch, understanding how things work under the hood, and occasionally reinventing the wheel just to see if I can make one myself.

Here is a collection of projects I've worked on, each representing a part of my journey as a software engineer.

projects.title: Nepali Crime News
projects.description: A simple project that crawls Nepal Police's official website every day and keeps the news in JSON format so any application can access it for free and use it.
